svg.title: Prathamesh Pawar, software engineer in India. Sticky notes: right now, release owner for a four-app production suite; superpower, making it run on a fresh laptop with zero API keys. A rubber stamp reads: certified, works on your machine.
svg.text: I build software end to end: from the first messy
conversation, through the architecture and the code, to
the release. And I like the parts most people skip.
